verdicts.reason: A and B are nearly identical and both are broken. The two hero food photos have shrunk to thumbnails and are scattered among empty decorative frames and a detached peach block. A large pasta-pattern panel takes up the space the imagery should have. The ornament fragments (the plate sketch and the brush strokes) float with no grouping, so the original's framed brand panel and two-photo structure are lost. Headline, Cascadia logo and URL are readable, but the layout looks like an exploded pile of layers. The differences between A and B (B's headline and spacing are a touch smaller) don't matter.
